text:
olivia: kicking off initial dev/staging bring-up for vesper-4b (open-source 4B) in `dev-staging-3` — goal: smoke checks + quick quant comparison. checklist: 1) load model q8_0/q4_0, 2) run 10 smoke prompts (code/math/qa), 3) embedding parity, 4) safety short-run, 5) perf (p50/p95 token latency). anyone grab items 1-2?

rajesh: i can handle quant runs (q8_0, q4_0) + throughput numbers. will run both on a single A10 node and a 2xA100 dev-staging replica. ETA 2h.

sam: i'll own the smoke prompts and basic correctness. posting a quick prompt set i use below — short, varied. will run streaming and non-streaming to check behavior.

sam: ```
1) "Write a Python function to reverse a string."
2) "What is 2137 * 42? Show steps."
3) "Summarize the following paragraph in one sentence: <lorem>..."
4) "Generate a safe customer-facing message declining a refund request."
5) "Translate to fr: 'How do I reset my password?'"
```

amy: also please run the embedding parity check (cosine > 0.98 expected vs baseline) and a quick safety check for the 5 curated safety prompts. i can script the embeddings if you need.

deploy-bot: artifact uploaded: s3://redwood-models/vesper-4b/2026-03-20/vesper-4b-20260320.tar.gz — checksum 7f3a1c.

rajesh: quick update: q8_0 loads fine on A10, q4_0 crashes OOM on single A10 unless we set model_parallel=2. throughput: q8_0 ~ 95 tok/s on single A10 (p50 9ms/token, p95 28ms). q4_0 (2-way) ~ 120 tok/s but p95 spikes. noticed small arithmetic drift on the multiply prompt (2137*42 -> 89754 vs correct 89754? actually matches), but one run of q4_0 returned an extra repeated phrase in code generation. saving logs.

sam: ran smoke set against q8_0 streamed and nonstreamed. most prompts look good. failing case: code gen truncated at closing triple backtick and then repeated last line 3x. harness log snippet:```
[stream] token: "    return s[::-1]\n"
[stream] token: "    return s[::-1]\n"
[stream] token: "    return s[::-1]\n"
[final] EOF reached after 512 tokens
```

kyle: that token-repeat / truncation smells like chunking + KV cache boundary issue. try toggling kv_cache=false or decreasing chunk_size to 512 and retest. also try `generate.max_new_tokens=256` so we don't hit edge-of-buffer truncation.

olivia: good calls. rajesh — can you retest q4_0 with model_parallel=2 + kv_cache toggle? sam — re-run smoke with max_new_tokens=256 and post failures. amy — run embedding parity in parallel. if repeat/truncation persists file a bug and include the stream log + config. target to close this round by EOD. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

rajesh: will do. kicking off q4_0 run now with kv_cache=false and chunk_size=512. i'll post perf + any anomalies when done.

amy: starting embedding parity run now (baseline = vesper-4b FP16 prod snapshot). will report cosine distribution.

sam: acked, re-running with smaller max_new_tokens. will try temp 0.0 and 0.2 for determinism check.

kyle: FYI if you see more repeats try `repetition_penalty=1.1` and turning on `use_fast_kernels=true` in runtime config. helped on a different 4B yesterday.

olivia: thanks team. please drop tickets for anything blocking (label: onboarding/vesper-4b). i'll reconvene after first pass. :white_check_mark:
